items.source: NOTE: The default behavior of this message listener container is to never propagate an exception thrown by a message listener up to the JMS provider. Instead, it will log any such exception at WARN level. This means that from the perspective of the attendant JMS provider no such listener will ever fail. However, if error handling is necessary, then an implementation of the ErrorHandler strategy may be provided to the setErrorHandler(ErrorHandler) method. Note that JMSExceptions will be passed to the ErrorHandler in addition to (but after) being passed to an ExceptionListener, if one has been provided.
items.translation: 注意：此消息监听器容器的默认行为是从不将消息监听器抛出的异常传播到 JMS 提供者。相反，它将以WARN级别记录任何此类异常。这意味着从伴随的 JMS 提供者的角度来看，该监听器永远不会失败。然而，如果需要错误处理，则可以向setErrorHandler(ErrorHandler)方法提供一个ErrorHandler策略的实现。请注意，除了（但在之后）传递给ExceptionListener（如果已提供）之外，JMS 异常将被传递给ErrorHandler。

items.source: Note that the "sessionTransacted" flag is strongly recommended over JmsTransactionManager, provided that transactions do not need to be managed externally. As a consequence, set the transaction manager only if you are using JTA or if you need to synchronize with custom external transaction arrangements.
items.translation: 请注意，只要不需要外部管理事务，就强烈推荐使用"sessionTransacted"标志，而不是JmsTransactionManager。因此，仅在您使用 JTA 或需要与自定义外部事务安排同步时，才设置事务管理器。

items.source: Note that Sessions managed by an external transaction manager will always get exposed to JmsTemplate calls. So in terms of JmsTemplate exposure, this setting only affects locally transacted Sessions.

items.source: Usually holds a single JMS Connection that all listeners are supposed to be registered on, which is the standard JMS way of managing listener sessions. Can alternatively also be used with a fresh Connection per listener, for Jakarta EE style XA-aware JMS messaging. The actual registration process is up to concrete subclasses.
items.translation: 通常持有一个供所有监听器注册的单个 JMS `Connection`，这是管理监听器会话的标准 JMS 方式。也可以为每个监听器使用一个新的 Connection，以支持 Jakarta EE 风格的 XA 感知 JMS 消息传递。实际的注册过程由具体的子类决定。

items.translation: 或者，将 JMS Destination 对象指定为"destination"。

items.source: As of 6.2, the default is true: The listener container will acknowledge each JMS Message even in case of a vendor-specific mode, assuming client-acknowledge style processing for custom vendor modes.

items.source: NOTE: Aborting receive attempts for such incoming messages might lead to the provider's retry count decreasing for the affected messages. If you have a high number of concurrent consumers, make sure that the number of retries is higher than the number of consumers, to be on the safe side for all potential stopping scenarios.

items.source: "sessionAcknowledgeMode" set to "AUTO_ACKNOWLEDGE" (default): This mode is container-dependent: For DefaultMessageListenerContainer, it means automatic message acknowledgment before listener execution, with no redelivery in case of an exception and no redelivery in case of other listener execution interruptions either. For SimpleMessageListenerContainer, it means automatic message acknowledgment after listener execution, with no redelivery in case of a user exception thrown but potential redelivery in case of the JVM dying during listener execution. In order to consistently arrange for redelivery with any container variant, consider "CLIENT_ACKNOWLEDGE" mode or - preferably - setting "sessionTransacted" to "true" instead.
items.translation: 将"sessionAcknowledgeMode"设置为"AUTO_ACKNOWLEDGE"（默认值）：此模式取决于容器：对于DefaultMessageListenerContainer，它表示在监听器执行之前自动确认消息，如果发生异常或其他监听器执行中断，则不会重新投递。对于SimpleMessageListenerContainer，它表示在监听器执行之后自动确认消息，如果抛出用户异常则不会重新投递，但如果 JVM 在监听器执行期间崩溃则可能会重新投递。为了在任何容器变体中一致地安排重新投递，请考虑使用"CLIENT_ACKNOWLEDGE"模式，或者（更优选）将"sessionTransacted"设置为"true"。

items.source: Or wrap your entire processing with an XA transaction, covering the receipt of the JMS message as well as the execution of the business logic in your message listener (including database operations etc). This is only supported by DefaultMessageListenerContainer, through specifying an external "transactionManager" (typically a JtaTransactionManager, with a corresponding XA-aware JMS ConnectionFactory passed in as "connectionFactory").
items.translation: 或者用 XA 事务包裹整个处理过程，涵盖接收 JMS 消息以及在您的消息监听器中执行业务逻辑（包括数据库操作等）。这仅由 DefaultMessageListenerContainer 支持，方法是指定一个外部“事务管理器”（通常是 JtaTransactionManager），并传入一个对应的 XA 感知 JMS ConnectionFactory 作为"connectionFactory"。

items.source: "sessionAcknowledgeMode" set to "DUPS_OK_ACKNOWLEDGE": Lazy message acknowledgment during (DefaultMessageListenerContainer) or shortly after (SimpleMessageListenerContainer) listener execution; no redelivery in case of a user exception thrown but potential redelivery in case of the JVM dying during listener execution. In order to consistently arrange for redelivery with any container variant, consider "CLIENT_ACKNOWLEDGE" mode or - preferably - setting "sessionTransacted" to "true" instead.
items.translation: 将"sessionAcknowledgeMode"设置为"DUPS_OK_ACKNOWLEDGE"： 在 (DefaultMessageListenerContainer) 期间或 shortly after (SimpleMessageListenerContainer) 监听器执行后采用Lazy消息确认； 若用户抛出异常则不会重新投递，但在监听器执行期间 JVM 崩溃时可能会重新投递。若要确保在任何容器变体中一致地安排重新投递，请考虑使用"CLIENT_ACKNOWLEDGE"模式，或者——更优选地——将"sessionTransacted"设置为"true"。

items.source: "sessionAcknowledgeMode" set to "CLIENT_ACKNOWLEDGE": Automatic message acknowledgment after successful listener execution; best-effort redelivery in case of a user exception thrown as well as in case of other listener execution interruptions (such as the JVM dying).
items.translation: 将"sessionAcknowledgeMode"设置为"CLIENT_ACKNOWLEDGE"：在成功执行监听器后自动确认消息；如果抛出用户异常或发生其他监听器执行中断（例如 JVM 崩溃），则尽力重试投递。

items.source: "sessionTransacted" set to "true": Transactional acknowledgment after successful listener execution; guaranteed redelivery in case of a user exception thrown as well as in case of other listener execution interruptions (such as the JVM dying).
items.translation:
将 `sessionTransacted` 设置为 `"true"`：
成功执行监听器后的事务性确认；
如果抛出用户异常或发生其他监听器执行中断（例如 JVM 崩溃），则保证重新投递。

items.source: Either add duplicate message detection to your listener, in the form of a business entity existence check or a protocol table check. This usually just needs to be done in case of the JMSRedelivered flag being set on the incoming message (otherwise just process straightforwardly). Note that with "sessionTransacted" set to "true", duplicate messages will only appear in case of the JVM dying at the most unfortunate point possible (i.e. after your business logic executed but before the JMS part got committed), so duplicate message detection is just there to cover a corner case.
items.translation: 要么在您的监听器中添加重复消息检测，形式为业务实体存在性检查或协议表检查。这通常仅在传入消息的 JMSRedelivered 标志被设置时才需要执行（否则直接处理即可）。请注意，当"sessionTransacted"设置为"true"时，重复消息仅会在 JVM 在最不幸的时刻死亡的情况下出现（即您的业务逻辑已执行但 JMS 部分尚未提交之前），因此重复消息检测只是为了覆盖一个边缘情况。

items.source:
The general recommendation is to set "sessionTransacted" to "true",
typically in combination with local database transactions triggered by the
listener implementation, through Spring's standard transaction facilities.
This will work nicely in Tomcat or in a standalone environment, often
combined with custom duplicate message detection (if it is unacceptable
to ever process the same message twice).
items.translation: 通常建议将"sessionTransacted"设置为"true"，通常与由监听器实现触发的本地数据库事务结合使用，通过 Spring 的标准事务设施进行。这在 Tomcat 或独立环境中效果良好，通常还会结合自定义的重复消息检测（如果处理同一消息两次是不可接受的）。
